subject.title: Gateway Dashboard chat buttons lose busy state after tab switch and can interrupt active runs

question: Should maintainers keep this issue open behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41067, treat current main's hasActiveRun recovery as sufficient and close both paths, or request a current-main replacement PR?
rationale: The issue is valid and current main has meaningful recovery code, but the same-author closing PR is still open/conflicting and this review lacks live proof of the exact tab-return workflow.

options.title: Keep open behind the linked PR
options.body: Recommended: leave this issue open until the linked PR is rebased/proven, replaced, or explicitly closed as obsolete.

options.title: Close as current-main fixed
options.body: A maintainer can decide that current hasActiveRun recovery fully solves the issue, but should also dispose of the linked PR to avoid a split state.

options.title: Request replacement PR
options.body: Close or pause the stale candidate PR and ask for a narrower current-main fix with live Dashboard proof.

recommendation.title: Keep open behind the linked PR
recommendation.body: Recommended: leave this issue open until the linked PR is rebased/proven, replaced, or explicitly closed as obsolete.

likelyOwner.reason: Their current-main refactor owns the present chat/session state paths a replacement or close proof would need to evaluate.
